mission: Morning on Veranthos. Torin is already awake in the spot where Ben left him last night. His Force presence is lighter, sharper — the heaviness that has defined him since awakening is gone. He has been meditating near the Scar overnight and is not hiding it. Ben confronts him. Torin is honest in a way that makes the truth worse.
why_now: The ridgeline vigil of Ch20 needed its morning. The turn has to happen in daylight, in conversation, not as an ambush — so the choice to let him go in sc2 has weight.
conflict: Ben is trying to prevent something he cannot stop by talking. Torin is not hiding. He is not manipulating. He is telling Ben the honest shape of a decision made a thousand years ago and confirmed in the breach zone. The horror is in the warmth.
turning_point: Torin describes the first time he used the technique — the moment of beauty, clarity without categories. 'It was the truest thing I've ever felt.' Then: 'I'm not asking for permission.' Five words. Nobody moves.
opening_hook: Torin is already awake when Ben emerges. He's standing in the same spot as last night. But something is different. He looks... rested. In a place where no one sleeps well.
closing_hook: Torin: 'I'm not asking for permission.' Five words. Nobody moves.
emotional_trajectory: Concerned confrontation -> Torin's devastating honesty -> the five words that break everything

stakes.personal: Ben watching a pattern he has seen before complete in front of him
stakes.interpersonal: The group's strongest member declaring independence
stakes.external: Torin's plan would work, at the cost of every principle the book has been arguing for

setting: Veranthos — camp at valley edge, dawn, the Scar visible below
sensory_details: Dawn light on Veranthos — golden but the shadows fall at slightly wrong angles; Torin's Force presence lighter and sharper, the heaviness that has defined him gone; his voice calm and warm and certain; the Scar below, outlined now by sunrise as it was outlined last night by stars
action_beats: Ben emerges from the tent at dawn to find Torin standing in the same spot — rested, lighter, his Force presence changed overnight
Ben confronts Torin at the ridgeline and Torin turns without shifting his weight — already grounded, already decided
Torin speaks five words and the temperature between them drops to absolute zero
promises_paid: Torin's certainty is dangerous and he will act on it (PP04)
notes: R11 — 'I'm not asking for permission.' The turn must be devastating because of its warmth, not despite it. Torin is not a villain. He is a hero making the wrong choice for reasons he can defend. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, interior-paragraph Torin's pattern as a thesis about corruption arcs. He argues, he watches the argument not work, he registers the five-word line. Torin's arc crosses its point-of-no-return here. Voice: dialogue-drama precision; permitted Stover-interior beat at the end of the scene, a sentence fragment at most, as Ben absorbs the refusal.
